node.title: The Human Side of Tiger Teams
node.reading:
A Tiger Team is a human architecture built around shared exposure and compressed accountability. Trust, camaraderie and learning are not cultural extras; they are part of how the operating model remains coherent.

Most discussions about distributed work focus on tools, locations, productivity and flexibility.

A Tiger Team is not simply a group of people working remotely. It is not a senior freelance network. It is not a delivery team waiting for instructions from a PMO. It is not a collection of specialists protected by layers of coordination, escalation and contractual distance.

When decision, execution, coordination and responsibility are separated, the human experience is very different. A specialist may receive a task, deliver it correctly, report a blocker, wait for escalation, and continue operating with limited personal exposure to the consequences of the overall programme. If the project fails, the individual may still have done their part correctly.

In a Tiger Team, the person does not only own a task. The person shares responsibility for the integrity of the mission. The work may be distributed across countries, time zones and technical domains, but accountability is not pushed somewhere else.
node.readingSummary: A Tiger Team is a human architecture built around shared exposure and compressed accountability.

relations: Trust supports collaboration, but timely review still depends on explicit decision context and actual response capacity.
Confianza social y capacidad cognitiva no son medidas equivalentes ni una sustituye a la otra.
Functional trust can support early disclosure of uncertainty when protecting the mission requires giving up a locally favourable account of progress.
La confianza no prueba coherencia y el desacuerdo puede ser correcto; conservar canales de revisión y contraste independientes.
An intense intervention should end with recovery and transfer conditions that preserve the team's capability rather than treating sustained overload as proof of commitment.
No se diagnostica atrofia clínica ni se confirma irreversibilidad a partir de un relato de cansancio.
Human accountability requires effective intervention capacity as well as authority; a nominal approval does not repair an unsupported or time-expired decision.
Propuesta de revisión de gobierno; no se certifica la dotación ni la seguridad de ningún equipo real.
For a complementary reading, see [How tacit capability is transmitted through shared work](https://jubap.net/tacit-knowledge-management-in-distributed-tiger-teams/).
